_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "word_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "srs_cards" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jp_to_meaning', "label_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NULL, "interval_days" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "ease" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_orphan" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("card_type", "item_id", "direction"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lesson_progress" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lesson_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" REAL NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reading_progress" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "story_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_achievements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "achievement_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "unlocked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "study_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "prev_state" TEXT NULL, "prev_interval" REAL NULL, "new_interval" REAL NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL, "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answered_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "study_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_scores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "game" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "accuracy" REAL NULL, "played_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_freezes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "covered_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coin_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_stats" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "new_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "review_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "correct_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "study_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "xp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("date", "device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "island_inventory" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "x" REAL NULL, "y" REAL NULL, "placed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "current" INTEGER NULL, "longest" INTEGER NULL, "last_active_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pull_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("table_name"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_packs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NULL, "installed_at" TEXT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "query" TEXT NOT NULL, "searched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL);
